items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch einlegen. Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse, Gesundheitsplatz 5, 30159 Musterstadt, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 21.05.2026; assumed handed to the post the same day. Under § 37 SGB X a postal notice is deemed delivered on the 3rd day after posting: 21.05.+3 days = 24.05.2026, a Sunday (Pfingstsonntag). The following day, 25.05.2026, is also a public holiday in NRW (Pfingstmontag), so under the analogous weekend/holiday rule the delivery fiction shifts to the next working day: Tuesday 26.05.2026 = date of Bekanntgabe. Per § 26 SGB X i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted; the one-month period then ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of delivery, i.e. 26.06.2026 (Friday) - not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday in NRW, so § 193 BGB requires no further shift.

items.title: First monthly contribution collected by direct debit
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: Membership and thus the first contribution period begins 01.06.2026 (June). Contributions are collected on the 15th of the month following the covered month, so the first collection (for June) falls on 15.07.2026, a Wednesday and business day, requiring no adjustment. This is an automatic recurring SEPA direct debit, so the person only needs to ensure sufficient account cover; subsequent debits follow monthly on the 15th.
